thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert --> redwood-prod-p95-p99-channel triggered (summary: p99 latency > 2.5s across eu-west cluster)

pagerduty-bot: Incident #87421 created · Acknowledgement required · https://pagerduty.example/incident/87421

alex_oncall: acked the alert :hand: investigating tail latency in eu-west. grabbing dashboard now.

maya_sre: seeing a p95->p99 spike from 21:40 UTC, looks correlated with kvcache eviction rate. metrics: `p95=480ms`, `p99=2.8s`, `evictions/sec=1200` in the last 3m.

josh_infra: checking autoscaler logs and node churn. nothing obvious in GCE autoscale events. no recent deploys.

lina_support: any visible customer errors? Support queue shows ~30 requests referencing timeouts for embed calls, mostly EU customers. ticket ids: T-1292, T-1293.

alex_oncall: ok, preliminary impact: some hosted API requests (multi-token gen) are timing out -> retries increasing client latency. propagating to customers on status page?

noah_pm: please flag any high-touch customers. I'll prep comms if this holds >30m.

maya_sre: running quick KV cache probe: `curl -s https://kvcache-metrics.internal/eu-west/summary | jq .hotkeys` shows a hot key spike on `user_ctx:org-4873` with heavy get/put rate. potential hotkey causing eviction cascade.

alex_oncall: can we temporarily blackhole that key or route it to dedicated pool?

josh_infra: we have a per-tenant routing rule but it's static. quick mitigation: increase kvcache shard count for eu-west pool and bump memory limits on sidecars to reduce eviction rate. applying patch now (will cause small restart of sidecar process only).

pagerduty-bot: alex_oncall acknowledged the incident at 21:41 UTC.

alex_oncall: running the sidecar memory bump (kubectl patch daemonset kvcache-sidecar -n eu-west --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"sidecar","env":[{"name":"SIDECAR_MAX_MEM","value":"1024Mi"}]}]}}}}')

maya_sre: while that's rolling, I'm enabling prefix caching for repeated prompt prefixes (quick config toggle) to reduce duplicate KV lookups.

lina_support: support queue trending downward; timeouts fewer in last 2m. CC: oncall for any escalation from enterprise customers.

jen_custops: just had a call with customer Acme AI, they reported degraded throughput but not complete outage. They've been notified.
extra_notes: This thread includes bot notifications and an on-call coordination flow. Contains code snippets and quick mitigation commands.
